headline: BHP Outlines Strategy to Double South Australia Copper Output by 2040
summary: BHP has unveiled operational expansion plans to double its annual copper production capacity across its South Australia mining assets by the year 2040.
why: BHP is the world's largest diversified miner; copper is a core strategic metal required for global electrification and industrial transition.

impacts.name: BHP Group
impacts.why: Long-term output expansion increases future revenue capacity but requires sustained capital expenditure.
